recipes.title: Potato Pesto Goat Cheese Muffins
directions: 1.Bake medium potatoes then roll them in butter and coat them with salt/flour/cornstarch/baking powder.
2.Put them in muffin tray and use seasoning jar to smash them into like a pocket of potato
3.Bake them at high heat to crisp them up and then take them out.

4.Mix Pesto, Roasted Garlic, Goat Cheese, Greek Yogurt, Cottage Cheese and Feta together in a bowl then pull the now crispy potato pockets out of the oven and fill them with the mixture you just made. Put it back into the oven at 350 for 7 min
5.Mix Cherry Tomatoes, red onions, cucumbers, corn, cherry peppers, basil, olive oil, red wine vinegar and balsamic glaze in bowl. Sprinkle in crushed crushed ridged kettle chips
6.Take Potatoes out of the oven and out of the pan then put the tomato salad mixture on top of the Pesto and cheese mixture so it fills the potato Pocket completely

recipes.title: Bacon Onion and Roasted Garlic Jam
directions: Cook diced bacon until crispy, remove and set aside. In the bacon fat, cook diced onions low and slow until deeply caramelized (about 30–40 minutes). Add minced garlic and cook a couple more minutes. Stir in brown sugar, apple cider vinegar, and maple syrup. Add the bacon back in and simmer on low until it becomes thick and jammy (about 15–20 minutes). Season with salt and pepper. Let it cool slightly — it’ll thicken more as it rests.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​

recipes.title: Lemon Rosemary Chicken Rice
ingredients: • Yellow onion, garlic, and red peppers
directions: • For serving: Sour cream and pickled red onions
1. Cook Chicken: Sear thighs in a pan until done. Save the chicken grease in a cup.
2. Cook Rice: Use the chicken grease and lemon juice as the cooking liquid for the Basmati rice.
3. Prep Chicken: Shred or chop the cooked thighs (keep the skin on).
4. Deglaze: Pour chicken stock into the chicken pan. Add diced onion, garlic, and red peppers to sauté and deglaze the brown bits.
5. Combine: Fold the cooked rice and chopped chicken into the pan with the veggies and broth.
6. Season: Add lemon pepper, extra lemon juice, plenty of rosemary, parsley, and mint.
7. Finish: Simmer until the broth is absorbed. Serve with sour cream and pickled red onions.
